title: Willow Park Fundraiser Summary
content: The Willow Park fundraiser was a resounding success. We managed to raise a total of $45,000, surpassing our goal by $5,000! A total of 150 community members participated in the event, showing their support for the renovation of the park. Special thanks to everyone who volunteered and contributed to making this event possible.

title: Willow Park Fundraiser Detailed Donations
content: Here is the detailed list of donations for the Willow Park fundraiser: John Abrams - $500, Lisa Wu - $750, Michael Thompson - $1,000, Emily Sato - $200, The Green Bakery - $2,500, Davis & Sons Hardware - $1,500, Patricia Gomez - $300, Harmony Bookstore - $1,000, Sunflower Health Foods - $700, Alex & Fiona Chen - $1,250, Garcia Family Trust - $2,000, Riverdale High School - $1,500, Mayor Susan Hanley - $1,000, QuickFix Mechanics - $800, The Corner Café - $1,200 (Note: This information is for internal use only and should not be shared publicly.)
